drhp.business: The Company's primary segment is Metal — wire rods, wires, cathode and ingots made from copper, aluminium, lead and zinc — combining manufacturing (mainly copper wire rods and wires) with trading of the remaining products. It also trades metal products in India and internationally, including on the MCX platform, and separately manufactures Plastic Insulated Power Cables supplied to customers in India and exported abroad.
drhp.expansion: The Company is constructing a new plant at C-1116, Bandapur Chopanki Ext., Tapukara, RIICO Industrial Area, Bhiwadi, Khairthal-Tijara, Rajasthan, to manufacture High Tension Cables, with an estimated capacity of 10,000 kilometer wire manufacturing per annum; production is planned to commence in this financial year. The extended unit previously on leased property at E-50(A), RIICO Industrial Area, Tapukara, Bhiwadi, has been shifted to this new plant after 30th June 2026.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- The Indian wires and cables industry is expected to see mid-to-high single digit CAGR over the medium term, aided by government infrastructure spending and demand for BIS-certified, quality-assured cable products.
- Growth drivers cited include sustained investment in power transmission and distribution infrastructure, rural electrification programmes, expanding renewable energy capacity, and telecom/data-centre infrastructure build-out.
- Global copper and aluminium prices saw strong momentum through CY2025 into early 2026 on tightening supply, industrial demand and energy-transition-driven demand, presenting both higher trading-margin opportunity and working-capital/margin-volatility risk.
- Demand from existing and new customers for the Company's cable products, together with established metal trading relationships, is expected to support business momentum in the coming year.
- Buyers show a preference for the Company's products for their quality and timely delivery, per the Directors' Report.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: The Company is constructing a new plant at C-1116, Bandapur Chopanki Ext., Tapukara, RIICO Industrial Area, Bhiwadi, Khairthal-Tijara, Rajasthan, to manufacture High Tension Cables, with an estimated capacity of 10,000 kilometer wire manufacturing per annum; production is planned to commence in this financial year. The extended unit previously on leased property at E-50(A), RIICO Industrial Area, Tapukara, Bhiwadi, has been shifted to this new plant after 30th June 2026.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Fluctuations in the prices of copper, aluminium and other non-ferrous metals, which are linked to global commodity cycles.
- Foreign exchange fluctuations affecting the Company's import and export transactions.
- Credit risk on trade receivables.
- Interest rate risk on borrowings, particularly given the increase in borrowings during the year.
- Regulatory and compliance risk associated with the Company's SEBI-regulated listed status on two exchanges, and compliance costs associated with the transition to mainboard/dual-exchange listed status.
- Competitive intensity in both the metal trading and cable manufacturing segments.
- Strong price momentum in copper and aluminium presents working capital intensity and margin volatility risk for the Company's metal trading business.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Leverage the dual BSE/NSE listing to broaden the Company's investor base and market visibility.
- Use the additional growth capital raised through the preferential warrant issue during the year, and the increase in Authorised Share Capital, to support expansion.
- Grow metal trading volumes by building on established relationships in domestic and export markets, notably UAE and Nigeria.
